edges.reason: msg.sender is the account credited in stake(uint256) and used for balance updates.
msg.sender is the account debited in withdraw(uint256).
msg.sender claims its own accrued rewards in getReward.
msg.sender supplies the reward tokens pulled by notifyRewardAmount.
The recipient of the reward transfer is the caller-derived address msg.sender, an external call target.
stake gates participation on block.timestamp versus periodFinish and periodStop.
lastTimeRewardApplicable derives its result directly from block.timestamp.
notifyRewardAmount schedules rewardRate and periodFinish from block.timestamp.
stake is guarded by the updateReward modifier.
withdraw is guarded by the updateReward modifier.
getReward is guarded by the updateReward modifier.
notifyRewardAmount applies updateReward(address(0)).
updateReward recomputes rewardPerToken().
updateReward recomputes earned(account).
updateReward recomputes lastTimeRewardApplicable().
updateReward writes the rewards[account] checkpoint before any external interaction.
updateReward writes userRewardPerTokenPaid[account].
updateReward stores the recomputed rewardPerTokenStored.
exit() calls withdraw(balanceOf(msg.sender)).
exit() calls getReward() after withdrawing.
stake calls getStakedValuesinUSD(msg.sender) to evaluate the stake limit.
stake compares the computed total stake against totalStakeLimit.
getStakedValuesinUSD prices the stake via getAmountOut(minPriceAmount, route).
getStakedValuesinUSD makes an external call into the stakeToken/pool contract for reserves.
getStakedValuesinUSD reads stakeToken.totalSupply() and the LP reserve of the staked token.
getStakedValuesinUSD divides the computed value by minPriceAmount.
getStakedValuesinUSD reads route[0] as the base asset for LP valuation.
getAmountOut resolves the swap path through emiFactory.
stake performs an external safeTransferFrom on the stake token inside the limit check flow.
withdraw performs an external safeTransfer of the stake token to the caller.
getReward performs an external rewardToken.safeTransfer to the caller.
notifyRewardAmount performs an external rewardToken.safeTransferFrom from the caller.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an owner-supplied token contract.
stakeToken address is the target of the stake transferFrom call.
stakeToken address is the target of the withdraw transfer call.
rewardToken is the asset moved by the getReward payout.
rewardToken is the asset pulled by notifyRewardAmount.
getReward reads earned(msg.sender) to size the payout.
getReward zeroes rewards[msg.sender] before transferring, which protects the payout ordering.
earned multiplies staked balance by (rewardPerToken - paid) with fixed-point math.
earned accumulates the stored rewards[account] value.
earned subtracts the userRewardPerTokenPaid[account] checkpoint.
rewardPerToken uses lastTimeRewardApplicable() as its time bound.
rewardPerToken accumulates rewardPerTokenStored using mul/div sequences that can overflow in Solidity 0.6.
rewardPerToken multiplies elapsed time by rewardRate.
lastTimeRewardApplicable reads periodFinish.
notifyRewardAmount derives rewardRate = reward.div(DURATION).
notifyRewardAmount extends periodFinish by DURATION.
notifyRewardAmount sets lastUpdateTime to block.timestamp.
notifyRewardAmount sets periodStop equal to periodFinish.
setPeriodStop updates the periodStop timestamp.
setEmiPriceData updates emiFactory.
setEmiPriceData rewrites the route array used for pricing.
setTotalStakeLimit updates totalStakeLimit.
setMinPriceAmount updates minPriceAmount.
tokenMode selects which valuation branch getStakedValuesinUSD executes.
stake updates the internal _balances mapping through super.stake.
stake increases _totalSupply through super.stake.
withdraw decreases the internal _balances mapping.
withdraw decreases _totalSupply.
The amount parameter drives the SafeMath add on _totalSupply and _balances in stake.
The amount parameter drives the SafeMath sub on _totalSupply and _balances in withdraw.
The reward parameter is divided by DURATION to derive rewardRate.
The local reward value is the amount passed to the external rewardToken.safeTransfer.
The local totalStake carries the computed pool total returned by getStakedValuesinUSD.
The local price carries the getAmountOut-derived valuation used by getStakedValuesinUSD.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only carries caller input into stake's balance accounting and stake-token pull, so it is normalized into the stake function node.
The reward parameter only feeds rewardRate and the rewardToken transfer inside notifyRewardAmount, so it collapses into that function node.
The local reward value exists only to size the payout inside getReward and is fully represented by that function together with its transfer operation.
The local totalStake is a transient return value of getStakedValuesinUSD and has no independent semantic role.
The local price is a transient intermediate of getStakedValuesinUSD and is merged into that function node.
